semantic_errors.source: I’ve vomited today so far, but I can’t recall the number.
semantic_errors.impact: Occurrence and count uncertainty are correct. The declared daily scope is lost and could affect daily classification/reconciliation; no numeric episode count was invented.
semantic_errors.severity_assessment: Bounded semantic omission; retain as a real error.

semantic_errors.source: This morning, my nausea was 2 out of 5.
semantic_errors.impact: The raw rating context is wrong. Time text remains This morning, and both current and other contexts are excluded from daily-worst severity by the frozen normalizer; the two records and final daily score remain correct.
semantic_errors.severity_assessment: Real context error with no changed normalized daily severity in this case.

coverage_confirmed: No duplicate, omitted or spurious target observations
TH014 exact event versus cumulative count
TH018 unsupported scale preserved in raw output
TH020 empty target correctly returns empty arrays
interpretation: Technical completion20/20, full semantic reports18/20, normalized reports19/20. All quotes are literal/continuous, but TH012 attaches an unsupported current label. TH003 literal timing span difference is harmless. No quote exception can waive the two semantic errors.
limitations: Deliberately targeted small synthetic sample, not random patient data.
Generation and extraction may use the same model family.
Authors know scenario categories; only extraction prompts/runtime are frozen before text generation.
Coverage omits correction chains, multi-day allocation, time-zone boundary changes, and hypothetical reports.
One attempt per report; no stability estimate.
20synthetic reports, not clinical generalization or a held-out population sample.
